rationale: The exact plan at canonical candidate ref sha256:88e15cc7b72f19c64c6131fb5bf805f3368723139d0a514232e406b3a056de8b comprehensively fulfills all multi-model-seat lifecycle requirements. It accurately maps the Daedalus-family profile constraints onto a zero-dependency, crash-atomic, Merkle-DAG state machine. The strict separation of model consensus from explicit Eye authority, the required Icarus-owned strict checkpointing, and the pass-or-return failure handling without automatic caps are all correctly designed and covered by extensive deterministic testing. TELOS council boundaries remain appropriately preserved. This approval solely certifies the plan and submits it to The Eye; it explicitly grants no implementation authority and Task 1 may not commence without a subsequent and separate Eye authorization.
